def transform(grid):
    # The input grid is 15x15. Separators are expected at row 7 and col 7 (value 4).
    # We identify the dimensions and separator location to be generic.
    n_rows = len(grid)
    n_cols = len(grid[0])
    
    # Determining separator row (index with all 4s)
    sep_row = 0
    for i in range(n_rows):
        if all(cell == 4 for cell in grid[i]):
            sep_row = i
            break
            
    # Determining separator col (index with all 4s)
    sep_col = 0
    for j in range(n_cols):
        # Assuming vertical separator
        is_sep = True
        for r in range(n_rows):
            if grid[r][j] != 4:
                is_sep = False
                break
        if is_sep:
            sep_col = j
            break
            
    # Extract Top-Left quadrant (TL)
    # TL covers rows 0 to sep_row-1, cols 0 to sep_col-1
    tl = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid[:sep_row]]
    
    # Initialize result grid as a copy of the input grid
    # This preserves the separator lines (row sep_row, col sep_col)
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Fill Top-Right (TR) quadrant:
    # Rows 0 to sep_row-1, Cols sep_col+1 to end
    # We assume TR, BL, BR are currently empty (2s) and need filling.
    for r in range(sep_row):

            result[r][sep_col+1:] = tl[r]
            
    # Fill Bottom-Left (BL) quadrant:
    # Rows sep_row+1 to end, Cols 0 to sep_col-1

        if sep_row + 1 < n_rows and sep_col > 0:
            result[sep_row+1+r][0:sep_col] = tl[r]
            
    # Fill Bottom-Right (BR) quadrant:
    # Rows sep_row+1 to end, Cols sep_col+1 to end
    for r in range(sep_row):
        if sep_row + 1 < n_rows and sep_col + 1 < n_cols:
            result[sep_row+1+r][sep_col+1:] = tl[r]
            
    return result
